# Scenario: Let's Encrypt rate-limit → ZeroSSL (Pebble EAB) fallback in prod mode.
# Primary CA is a local ACME stub that always returns 429; secondary is Pebble with EAB.
# Successful secondary must keep mode=prod and must NOT write .downgradeCertMode.

# LEGO_CA_* must be set before apinfra (pebble-start installs minica trust for both
# the HTTPS rate-limit stub and Pebble, which share the same fixture certs).
acme-ratelimit-start
pebble-start

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: acme fallback fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# dig stub so DNS preflight for cert-issue-type=prod succeeds without real DNS.
chmod 0755 bin/dig
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

exec apinfra
stderr 'trying secondary CA'
stderr 'secondary CA ok domain=e2e-fallback.apinfra.test mode=prod'
stderr 'cert issued name=e2e-fallback.apinfra.test mode=prod'
stderr 'done duration='
# lego writes ACME progress to stderr; do not require an empty stderr.

exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-fallback.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-fallback.apinfra.test/privkey.pem
# Successful FB must not schedule a mode downgrade.
! exists $HOME/.downgradeCertMode
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

# Dump host ACME state files for inspection (sibling of infra/).
exec sh -c 'echo "=== .retries ==="; if [ -f "$HOME/.retries" ]; then cat "$HOME/.retries"; else echo "(missing)"; fi'
exec sh -c 'echo "=== .downgradeCertMode ==="; if [ -f "$HOME/.downgradeCertMode" ]; then cat "$HOME/.downgradeCertMode"; else echo "(missing)"; fi'
exec sh -c 'echo "=== .events ==="; if [ -f "$HOME/.events" ]; then cat "$HOME/.events"; else echo "(missing)"; fi'

pebble-stop
acme-ratelimit-stop

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
certs.provider=letsencrypt
certs.zerossl.AcmeKid=kid-1
certs.zerossl.AcmeHmac=zWNDZM6eQGHWpSRTPal5eIUYFTu7EajVIoguysqZ9wG44nMEtx3MUAsUDkMTQ12W
certs.letsencrypt.directory=https://localhost:18080/directory
certs.letsencrypt.stagingDirectory=https://localhost:18080/directory
certs.zerossl.directory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-fallback.apinfra.test
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: prod
      cert-acme-email: e2e@apinfra.local

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do echo -e 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n\n OK' | nc -lk -p 80; done"
    container_name: e2e-web-container

-- bin/dig --
#!/bin/sh
# Fake dig for e2e DNS preflight (ignores flags; always returns a loopback A record).
echo '127.0.0.1'

-- .env --
